profile.visual_desc: Muscular blue-skinned demon with large bat-like wings. Wears a ragged brown loincloth and brown arm and leg wrappings. Features two-toed clawed feet.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up of a craggy blue demon face facing right. Features glowing red eyes, sharp lower fangs, dark horns, and a scowling expression.
profile.step1_ready: Faces down-right. Stands ready with clenched fists near the waist, wings folded downward.
profile.step2_windup: Raises both arms high and spreads wings wide, flexing torso to build momentum.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges down-right, thrusting both fists forward in a heavy double punch. No energy or light VFX is present.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the extended punch pose with wings flared, then pulls arms back into a recovery stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: No slash VFX is present; the attack is a purely physical double-fisted strike.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence replicates the reference flex and strike. Biomechanics are stable and motion trails align with the physical punch.
